description: Defines classes and functions for managing logical channels, including mapping (UE, LCID) pairs, handling buffer statuses, scheduling CEs, and managing UE-specific logical channel repositories within a scheduler system for 5G NR. It includes detailed data structures, methods for buffer management, slice association, and scheduling logic.

classes.name: logical_channel_mapper
classes.description: Helper class to map (UE, LCID) pairs to logical channel fields, manage slice associations, and QoS contexts.

classes.name: logical_channel_system
classes.description: Main system managing logical channels, buffer statuses, and UE contexts within the scheduler.

classes.name: ue_logical_channel_repository
classes.description: Handle for managing logical channels and buffer statuses for a specific UE.

classes.name: ue_logical_channel_repository_view
classes.description: Non-owning view providing read-only access to a UE's logical channel repository.

methods.name: slot_indication
methods.description: Signals the start of a new slot, updating internal states.

methods.name: create_ue
methods.description: Creates a new UE logical channel repository with specified configurations.

methods.name: nof_ues
methods.description: Returns the number of UEs managed by the system.

methods.name: nof_logical_channels
methods.description: Returns the total number of logical channels managed.

methods.name: get_ues_with_dl_pending_data
methods.description: Returns UEs with pending DL data for a specific RAN slice.

methods.name: get_ues_with_ul_pending_data
methods.description: Returns UEs with pending UL data for a specific RAN slice.
